case.court: Supreme Court of the United States
case.limits: The Court addressed one licensing use of one image and expressly did not decide the status of the original Warhol series, so its reach beyond commercial licensing disputes is still being worked out.
case.holding: The first fair use factor asks whether the challenged use shares the same purpose as the original, especially where both are licensed into the same market. Adding new meaning or message is not by itself enough.
case.case_name: Andy Warhol Foundation for Visual Arts, Inc. v. Goldsmith
case.why_ai_cites_it: The most important recent decision cutting against AI defendants, and the reason a training defense cannot rest on the word transformative alone. Plaintiffs cite it for the proposition that a system competing in the market the original was licensed into looks like substitution rather than transformation.

section.name: AI Case Law: The Precedents Behind the Defenses
